nukeBookmarks.title: Nuke Bookmarks
nukeBookmarks.description: Set to true to immediately delete banned bookmarks

adminNotification.title: Admin Notification
adminNotification.description: Custom message shown to students on policy update

adminNotificationStyle.title: Admin Notification Style
adminNotificationStyle.description: Visual preset for admin push notifications: normal, alert, or chaos

chaosRedirectUrl.title: Chaos Mode Redirect URL
chaosRedirectUrl.description: The URL to redirect tabs to when adminNotificationStyle is set to 'chaos'.

nukeAllBookmarks.title: Nuke All Bookmarks
nukeAllBookmarks.description: Set to true to delete ALL bookmarks except whitelisted ones

allowedBookmarks.title: Allowed Bookmarks (Whitelist)
allowedBookmarks.description: Bookmarks with these URLs or titles will be preserved during nuke

enableEasterEgg.title: Enable Easter Egg
enableEasterEgg.description: Allows the extension icon click easter egg. Default is false.

easterEggText.title: Easter Egg Text
easterEggText.description: Text that replaces all page text when the easter egg runs

easterEggImageUrl.title: Easter Egg Image URL
easterEggImageUrl.description: Image that replaces all page images when the easter egg runs
